Hi Maya —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. Quick checklist from Procurement so we can move to PO creation and finance routing:

1) Insurance minimums we need verified on the COI(s):
   - General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Errors & Omissions (E&O): $1,000,000
   - Cyber/Privacy: $1,000,000 (with retroactive date or claims-made coverage noted)
   - Redwood Inference listed as additional insured on GL (endorsement) where applicable

2) COI specifics: policy effective dates, insurer contact, and certificate holder name exactly: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 425 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105". If the COI is missing the additional-insured endorsement or the certificate-holder text, we will request an updated COI from your broker.

3) Tax / payment information: signed W9 with remit-to address or instructions. We also need the vendor's tax ID on file for PO setup.

4) Procurement form: please complete the short vendor intake form at the link below (helps finance set up payment terms / tax classification):
   https://drive.redwoodinference.com/teams/procurement/vendor-intake-template

Estimated timeline from our side: once we have updated COI(s) meeting the minimums and a signed W9, Procurement will open a vendor record and submit a PO request to Finance. Typical internal turnover is 3-5 business days after complete evidence is received; we can expedite to 24–48 hours if finance confirms priority.

If you can send the insurer name and broker email (so we can validate the COI), that speeds things up a lot. Also please confirm whether invoices should reference a PO number (yes/no) and the remit-to email for e-invoicing.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
